differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned at a low, oblique angle relative to the keyboard grid, creating a strong perspective effect.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned at a higher, more top-down angle, resulting in a flatter perspective.
differences.fix: Adjust the camera pitch and height to match the oblique perspective of the reference.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame are significantly darker than the center, showing a distinct vignette effect.
differences.b_observable: The lighting is more uniform across the frame with less corner falloff.
differences.fix: Add a vignette effect to darken the corners of the frame.

differences.a_observable: The white keys have a soft, cool blue-green color cast, especially in the shadowed areas.
differences.b_observable: The white keys are neutral white/grey with no cool color cast.
differences.fix: Adjust the white balance or add a cool color grade to match the reference's blue-green cast.

differences.a_observable: The recess/well around the yellow 'Recurly' card has a soft, light-grey inner shadow.
differences.b_observable: The recess/well around the yellow 'Recurly' card has a very dark, harsh black border.
differences.fix: Soften and lighten the inner shadow of the button recesses.

differences.a_observable: The yellow 'Recurly' button has a glossy surface with visible specular highlights reflecting the light source.
differences.b_observable: The yellow 'Recurly' button has a matte finish with diffuse reflection and no distinct specular highlights.
differences.fix: Increase the specular glossiness and reduce roughness of the yellow button material.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera angle and perspective to match the oblique view of the reference, and soften the dark, harsh shadows in the button recesses.
